criterion: Descending GitHub stars among inspected open-source repositories with in-tree JAX/Pallas computational implementations and explicit TPU evidence; archived and retained legacy code eligible. Teaching repositories containing actual computational source are eligible; documentation-only lists or empty TPU headings are not implementations.
limitations: This is a reproducible research snapshot of the documented discovery queries and manual source checks, not a GitHub-wide completeness theorem.
Stars may change during retrieval; snapshots pin each tested source independently of ranking observation.
Repository inclusion does not imply full model/whole repository validation or availability of TPU hardware.
Discovery hits from resource lists and unrelated frameworks are explicitly marked metadata triage; no claim is made that every line of those repositories was audited.
